_readme: Product registry for the Monday pin batch builder. Pin ONLY products with "live": true and a real Etsy listing URL. To add a product once it is live on Etsy: set live to true, paste its listing URL into link, and check its board exists on Pinterest (exact name). Screens for each product live in tools/screens/<key>/. Facts and numbers on pins must come from those screens or the notes here.

endoflife.kw: end of life planner, if i die binder uk, death binder, estate planning uk, will template uk
endoflife.notes: UK only (England & Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland). Fillable A4 PDF + printable PDF + linked tracker + UK will templates with signing guidance.
